sample_unit: evaluations (178 single-response ratings and 83 pairwise comparisons)
unlisted_practices: Comparing LLM-generated health coaching responses against human health coach responses using expert, lay-user and GPT-4 evaluators
Using GPT-4 as an automated evaluator of LLM output quality alongside human experts
Grounding an open-source LLM with retrieval-augmented generation for health coaching

screen.reason: The study evaluates a RAG-enabled LLM against human health coaches using retrospective client questions evaluated offline by experts, lay users, and GPT-4. It evaluates model response quality but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail comparison.
